authorInfo.bio: Arthur Sullivan · W. S. (William Schwenck) Gilbert (1842–1900) is the author of The Complete Plays of Gilbert and Sullivan. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
